mapper.select: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pay04_start_date) AS formula_id, pay04_start_date AS start_date FROM pay04_formula WHERE pay04_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY pay04_start_date ORDER BY pay04_start_date DESC

SELECT FROM pay04_formula INNER JOIN pay20_item ON pay20_item_cd = pay04_item_cd WHERE pay04_start_date = ( SELECT max(pay04_start_date) FROM pay04_formula INNER JOIN pay20_item ON pay20_item_cd = pay04_item_cd WHERE pay04_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay04_start_date <= current_date) AND pay04_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT pay04_formula_id AS formula_id, pay04_company_id AS company_id, pay04_start_date AS start_date, pay04_item_cd AS item_cd, (SELECT pay20_item_nm FROM pay20_item WHERE pay20_item_cd = pay04_item_cd LIMIT 1) AS item_name, pay04_formula_form AS formula_form, pay04_note AS note FROM pay04_formula WHERE pay04_formula_id = #{formulaId}
